issues.title: One transport failure is logged as Error in two layers

origin.quote: Why Error here? The transport already logs this.
origin.author: reviewer
origin.verdictReason: both layers log the same exception at Error

explanation.text: The same failure is logged at Error in two places.

options.label: Error once in SyncSession, transport logs Debug
Error once in the transport, SyncSession logs Debug
Keep both, add a correlation id

recommendation.reason: SyncSession is the layer that can act on the failure.

issues.title: Client older than the gateway: Warning or Information?

explanation.text: A client behind the gateway version can still work, but support wants to see the skew.

options.label: Warning for one release, then Information

recommendation.reason: Version skew is expected during rollouts and is not actionable.

dependsOn.note: If the transport owns the Error, skew must stay visible for one release.

issues.title: Request logging crashes when the request has no identity

explanation.text: The logger reads the user name without a null check and throws on anonymous requests.

recommendation.reason: A null guard is small and removes a crash.

issues.title: Retry attempts are logged too loud

explanation.text: Every retry attempt is logged at Warning, which floods the log during outages.

recommendation.reason: Only the final failure needs attention.

decision.note: Ops still wants these at Warning during the migration
